dict.string: To add your planned workouts to your calendar as repeating events.
To read steps, sleep, and weigh-ins from your devices (including Garmin via Apple Health) for your stats and trends.
To save your logged weight, water, nutrition, and workouts to Apple Health.
To check the temperature and humidity where you're training, so your hydration and sodium targets match the conditions. Your location is used for the weather lookup only — never stored, never shared.
To dictate your meal so AI can estimate its calories and protein.
To turn your spoken meal description into text for the AI estimate.
